run_prep_s2ut_data: run the prep_s2ut_data script to generate TSV manifests and config YAML from source audio and target unit directories
run_process_function: run the process function to generate manifest TSV files and config YAML for speech-to-speech translation data splits
run_main_cli: run the main CLI with --source-dir, --target-dir, and --output-root to preprocess S2UT data for fairseq training
review_process_function: review the process function that loads target units, matches source WAVs, and writes manifest TSVs per data split
review_main_cli: review the main CLI argument parser for --source-dir, --target-dir, --data-split, --output-root, --reduce-unit, and vocoder options
